findings.description: Removing Sentinel.__reduce_ex__ leaves the enum on its default pickling path, which rebuilds members from their object() value and so no longer round-trips UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE by identity.
findings.rationale: Under the trigger of pickling a value that holds UNSET or FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE, such as a parameter default or context object sent to a subprocess, the default enum reduce serializes the member's _value_ (a bare object()) and calls Sentinel(value) on load, which raises ValueError because no member matches the new object; the removed getattr-based reduce avoided this by resolving the member by name. The impact is that pickling or unpickling such objects fails, or at best yields a sentinel that no longer compares identical to UNSET.
